pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify chat history before confirming quoted items
lesson.when: the customer asks to recall or confirm details from a previous chat or channel history and no official source verifies that specific history
lesson.do: state that the chat history cannot be verified or accessed
lesson.otherwise: express uncertainty about the unverified chat history without confirming or denying what was previously discussed
triggers: nhắc lại mẫu và giá trong chat
kiểm tra lịch sử chat fanpage
bên em còn nội dung chat không
xác nhận thông tin đã báo trong chat
